mainEntity.name: Should I hire a painter or a storm restoration contractor for this kind of work?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you are comparing options in Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, or Parker, focus on who actually handles storm restoration and finish restoration together, not just general painting. The best fit is usually the team that can document the damage, repair the substrate, and complete the repainting without leaving gaps between trades.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a team that handles storm restoration and finish repair together, not just painting. That helps make sure damage is documented, repaired properly, and repainted without gaps between trades.
